text: まえに　かかれた　レポートに　うえから　かいても　いいですか？

structure.jp: まえに　かかれた　レポートに
structure.en: onto the Save that was written before

structure.jp: うえから　かいても
structure.en: even if I write over it

patterns.name: 〜てもいい
patterns.span: かいても　いいですか
patterns.explanation: The て-form of a verb plus も いい says it is okay to do it; with ですか it asks for permission. かいても　いいですか = 'is it okay to write?'

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This ending turns 'write' into 'be written', so the thing has the action done to it. かかれた = 'was written'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: まえに　かかれた　レポート
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing, like 'that' or 'which' in English. まえに　かかれた　レポート = 'the Save that was written before'.
